title: Filtering the products table by numbers · part 27

steps.title: Keep price >= 94.38
steps.prompt:
Numbers compare with small symbols:
  > bigger   < smaller   = exactly   != not equal
Keep the rows where price is at least 94.38.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price >= 94.38;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Add WHERE after the table name.
The test is price >= 94.38.
Write: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price >= 94.38;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price >= 94.38;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE keeps only the rows that pass the test.

steps.title: Count rows price >= 94.38
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) counts how many rows survive the filter.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE price >= 94.38;
hints: Start with SELECT count(*).
FROM products.
Add WHERE price >= 94.38.
Write: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE price >= 94.38;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE price >= 94.38;
steps.memory_trick: count(*) + WHERE = 'how many pass?'

steps.title: Filter then sort: price >= 94.38
steps.prompt:
Filter first, then ORDER BY tidies what is left.
LIMIT 3 keeps the top of that sorted list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price >= 94.38 ORDER BY price LIMIT 3;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM products.
Add WHERE price >= 94.38.
Add ORDER BY price LIMIT 3.
Write: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price >= 94.38 ORDER BY price LIMIT 3;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM products WHERE price >= 94.38 ORDER BY price LIMIT 3;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE trims, ORDER BY sorts, LIMIT cuts.
